notes: Only an upper budget bound ('under $2M') on the demand side. Correct = BUYER_ISO, no address leakage (the buyer is looking, not selling), neighborhood Chelsea, party captured. Watch for treating $2M as a listing price or emitting an address.

input.subject: ISO Chelsea 1-2BR Under $2M for Serious Buyer
input.bodyText:
Hi all,

I have a well-qualified buyer actively looking in Chelsea and would love to hear about anything off-market.

Looking for a 1-2BR, budget under $2M, flexible on floor and exposure. Pre-approved and needs to close by year-end - motivated and easy to work with.

If you have or know of anything quietly available, please send it my way. Happy to co-broke.

Thanks,
Rebecca Tanaka
SERHANT.
